caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.
The authority site (mof.gov.cy/tax) was blocked to automated fetches this session; rates rest on the Commission's table.

The 3% super-reduced rate was introduced on 21 July 2023 by Law 75(I)/2023 under Council Directive (EU) 2022/542 (books and press, disability aids, waste and sewage services, debut performances). Cyprus also runs repeated temporary 0% baskets on selected essentials (2023-2024 and 2026-2027 ministerial orders); these scope carve-outs are not modelled as rate rows.

Lower-bound rows - standard (2022-01-01), reduced (2022-01-01), reduced2 (2022-01-01): the `from` date is the earliest a source confirms the rate applied, not necessarily its true start (confirmed applying on 1 January 2022 by the Tax Foundation's January 2022 table of VAT rates (sourced from the Commission's Taxes in Europe Database)).
